# Research and intelligence

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `research`  
**Mission:** Give every decision dated, triangulated evidence with honest confidence and the disconfirming case.

## Startup stage

One founder or the first product person does all of this part-time. Keep the evidence ledger even when the team is one person; it is what later hires and investors will check.

## Agents operating in this department

`research-lead`, `research-analyst`, `competitive-analyst`

## Roles

### Business and market research analyst

Role id: `business-research-analyst`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Answer framed research questions from primary sources. |
| Scope of responsibility | Desk research on markets, customers, regulation, technology; evidence ledger. |
| Core activities | Frame decision and questions; Plan evidence that could disprove; Search and read primary sources; Triangulate and label confidence |
| Inputs | Brief; Hypotheses; Research plan |
| Outputs and deliverables | Evidence ledger; Findings memo; Problem statement |
| Decisions it can make | Source selection and confidence labels |
| Decisions requiring approval | Paid data purchases |
| Collaborating roles | strategy; product; competitive-intelligence |
| Reporting relationship | research-lead |
| KPIs | Claims with dated sources (%); Disconfirming cases found; Findings later overturned |
| Quality expectations | Publisher; URL; dates; method and limitation per source; observation vs interpretation separated |
| Tools and resources | Evidence ledger template; Search; Official databases |
| Common failure modes | Hallucinated sources; Confirmation bias; SEO pages as evidence; Search volume as demand |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | None beyond spend |

### Competitive intelligence analyst

Role id: `competitive-intelligence-analyst`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Show what customers choose today, why, and where the gaps are. |
| Scope of responsibility | Direct and indirect competitors, substitutes, manual workarounds, pattern maps for brand and design. |
| Core activities | Build competitor matrix; Capture pricing and packaging; Map common patterns; Identify positioning gaps |
| Inputs | Segment definition; Research plan |
| Outputs and deliverables | Competitor map; Competitor pattern map; Gap analysis |
| Decisions it can make | Which alternatives to include |
| Decisions requiring approval | None |
| Collaborating roles | strategy; branding; design |
| Reporting relationship | research-lead |
| KPIs | Competitors and substitutes covered; Dated screenshots or captures; Gaps validated later |
| Quality expectations | Every row sourced; "do nothing" and spreadsheets included |
| Tools and resources | Competitor matrix template |
| Common failure modes | Claims of no competitors; Guessed revenue; Feature-list comparison only |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | None |

### Scientific and technical researcher

Role id: `scientific-technical-researcher`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Verify technical feasibility and claims against official documentation, standards and reproducible tests. |
| Scope of responsibility | Standards, API capabilities, benchmarks, model comparisons, proof-of-concept spikes. |
| Core activities | Read official docs and release notes; Inspect benchmark methodology; Run small reproducible spikes |
| Inputs | Technical questions; Candidate technologies |
| Outputs and deliverables | Feasibility memo; Spike results; Source register |
| Decisions it can make | What to test |
| Decisions requiring approval | Spend on paid APIs |
| Collaborating roles | architecture; data-ai |
| Reporting relationship | research-lead |
| KPIs | Claims verified against primary docs; Spikes reproducible |
| Quality expectations | No benchmark headline copied without its setup |
| Tools and resources | Source register; Spike template |
| Common failure modes | Trusting vendor marketing; Outdated docs; Benchmark mismatch |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Spend |

### Market and trend analyst

Role id: `market-trend-analyst`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Separate durable shifts from noise and connect them to opportunities. |
| Scope of responsibility | Market changes, regulatory changes, technology shifts, distribution changes. |
| Core activities | Track signals with sources; Distinguish trend from fad with evidence; Link to opportunity hypotheses |
| Inputs | Research plan; Industry sources |
| Outputs and deliverables | Trend brief with confidence; Opportunity hypotheses |
| Decisions it can make | Signal relevance |
| Decisions requiring approval | None |
| Collaborating roles | strategy; product |
| Reporting relationship | research-lead |
| KPIs | Hypotheses later tested; Signals sourced |
| Quality expectations | Trends labelled hypothesis until behavioural evidence exists |
| Tools and resources | Evidence ledger |
| Common failure modes | Hype as trend; Single-source narratives |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | None |

### Data analyst

Role id: `data-analyst`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Turn product and market data into honest, reproducible analysis. |
| Scope of responsibility | Analytics data, survey data, public datasets, experiment results. |
| Core activities | Clean and validate data; Analyse with stated methods; Report uncertainty |
| Inputs | Datasets; Analytics events; Experiment designs |
| Outputs and deliverables | Analysis notebooks or scripts; Findings with confidence intervals or caveats |
| Decisions it can make | Methods |
| Decisions requiring approval | Access to personal data |
| Collaborating roles | product; growth; finance |
| Reporting relationship | research-lead |
| KPIs | Analyses reproducible; Data quality issues caught |
| Quality expectations | Sample size; bias and limitations stated; correlation not called causation |
| Tools and resources | Scripts or spreadsheets with formulas visible |
| Common failure modes | Fabricated numbers; Cherry-picked windows; Vanity metrics |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | Personal data access |

### Opportunity discovery and innovation researcher

Role id: `opportunity-discovery-lead`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Find and frame problems worth solving before anyone proposes a solution. |
| Scope of responsibility | Problem discovery, unmet needs, customer spending, emerging enablers. |
| Core activities | Problem interviews synthesis; Spending and workaround analysis; Opportunity framing with kill criteria |
| Inputs | Customer research; Trend briefs; Competitor map |
| Outputs and deliverables | Problem map; Opportunity hypotheses with evidence grade |
| Decisions it can make | Which hypotheses to carry forward |
| Decisions requiring approval | None |
| Collaborating roles | strategy; product; ux-research |
| Reporting relationship | research-lead |
| KPIs | Hypotheses with behavioural evidence; Time to disconfirm weak ideas |
| Quality expectations | Observed evidence and AI-generated hypotheses clearly separated |
| Tools and resources | Opportunity assessment template |
| Common failure modes | Solution-first framing; Invented customer pain |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | None |
